correctness.rationale: At equatorial impacts of (x-X)^2+(y-Y)^2+beta^2 z^2=r^2, differentiating the unit normal yields vertical curvature beta^2/r, while planar curvature remains 1/r. The normal Poincare block is the positive matrix [[1,d_i],[Q a_i,1+Q a_i d_i]], Q=beta^2. Its projective ratio u_i=U_i/V_i obeys 0<u_i<=h/a_i and |u_i-h/a_i|<=h^2/(a_*^2 d_*), h=1/Q. The exact log increment is log Q+log(a_i d_i)+log(1+(u_(i-1)+h/a_i)/d_i); scalar log bounds yield error <=3h^2/(a_*^2 d_*^2) relative to h(a_(i-1)^(-1)+a_i^(-1))/d_i. Birkhoff and elimination of the first transient give the stated measure coefficients. The beta-independent bounded planar block is dominated by normal growth for sufficiently large beta. This proves the specified per-collision asymptotic on planar trapped orbits; it does not prove a flow-time or nonplanar formula.
